Package org.ujorm

Interface Key<UJO,VALUE>

All Superinterfaces:
CharSequence, Comparable<Key>
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractKey
@Unmodifiable public interface Key<UJO,VALUE> extends CharSequence, Comparable<Key>
This interface is a descriptor of the Ujo attribute. The Key contains only meta-data; therefore, the implementation never contains business data. Each instance of the Key must be located in a public static final field of a Ujo implementation. The Key is not intended to be serializable because each instance is unique to its related Java field. An appropriate solution for serialization is to use a decorator class, such as KeyRing.
See general information about the framework or explore existing implementations.
Author:
Pavel Ponec
